issues.description: sample_rate not validated against allowed STTAudioFormat literals
issues.detail: STTv2.__init__ casts f"pcm_{sample_rate}" to STTAudioFormat without validation. Any unsupported value (e.g., 11025, 32000) silently becomes an invalid audio_format that the WebSocket will reject at runtime, producing an opaque connection error. Validate sample_rate against {8000,16000,22050,24000,44100,48000} and raise ValueError early.

issues.description: Parameter values are not URL-encoded when building ws_url
issues.detail: _connect_ws builds the query string with f-strings and "&".join. If language_code or future params contain special characters (spaces, &, =), the URL will be malformed. Use urllib.parse.urlencode for safety and correctness; this is the kind of latent bug that surfaces only with unusual locales.

issues.description: Documented VAD parameter ranges are not enforced
issues.detail: Docstring claims vad_silence_threshold_secs in [0.3, 3.0], vad_threshold in [0.1, 0.9], min_speech/silence_duration_ms in [50, 2000], but no validation occurs. Out-of-range values are silently forwarded to the server, producing confusing remote errors. Add bounds checks in __init__ matching the docstring.

issues.description: Raising APIConnectionError from message handler may not propagate cleanly
issues.detail: _process_stream_event raises APIConnectionError on server-side error messages, but it's called inside recv_task's broad try/except that only logs exceptions ("failed to process ElevenLabs STT message"). The error will be swallowed rather than terminating the stream, so quota_exceeded/auth_error never surface to the caller. Re-raise outside the except, or set a flag and break.

issues.description: Reconnection loop never triggers a reconnect
issues.detail: _run has scaffolding for reconnection via self._reconnect_event, but nothing in the class ever calls self._reconnect_event.set(). The branch handling reconnect is dead code; on any ws error, send_task/recv_task complete and the loop breaks. Either implement actual reconnect-on-error semantics or remove the unused machinery to avoid misleading future maintainers.

The branch only logs and never emits a SpeechEvent. If the server ever sends this type instead of committed_transcript, transcripts will be silently dropped. Either map it to FINAL_TRANSCRIPT (extracting .text) or document why it's intentionally ignored.

review.summary: The new STTv2 streaming integration follows the established pattern but has a few latent correctness gaps. The most pressing is that sample_rate is cast straight into an STTAudioFormat literal without validating it's one of the six supported PCM rates; invalid values produce opaque server-side failures. Documented VAD parameter ranges aren't enforced, error messages received over the WS may be swallowed by the recv_task try/except, and the reconnect_event plumbing is scaffolded but never triggered, which is misleading. URL params should also be properly encoded.
